caption: The drawing features a single object, a ladle, positioned diagonally across the page from the lower left to the upper right. The bowl of the ladle is a deep reddish-brown color, suggesting a copper or rusted metal material, and the metal appears somewhat aged with areas of darker greenish discoloration. The handle is long, cylindrical, and colored a light beige or off-white, with subtle bands and rings that add texture and detail; it is attached to the bowl at an angle. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Sugar Dipper
